title: Farmers stopped at Punjab-Haryana border en route to Delhi rally against India-U.S. trade deal
summary: Farmers wanted to peacefully go to Delhi and participate in the rally but the BJP-led Haryana government has stopped them by erecting barricades, Sarwarn Singh, a farmer leader, said.
